title: Bootstrap Next.js App Router TypeScript app in apps/web

title: Set up lint, formatting, strict typecheck and unit test commands

title: Initialize Supabase CLI and local migration workflow

title: Create accessible app shell and health endpoint

title: Add GitHub Actions CI quality workflow

title: Configure Vercel preview deployment runbook

title: Add automated RLS allow/deny tests

title: Implement Supabase Auth SSR lifecycle

title: Provision organization and first owner atomically

title: Implement membership invitations and status changes

title: Add centralized server-side authorization helpers

title: Add audit-event foundation for privileged actions

title: Build organization and campus context selector
acceptance_criteria: Users see only organizations/campuses they are assigned to|Switching context triggers server-side revalidation|Invalid IDs do not reveal other tenants|Selected context is not treated as proof of permission

title: Create institution settings and school/academy type configuration
acceptance_criteria: Organization can be configured as school, academy or both|Settings have validation and authorization|Language, timezone and locale defaults are explicit and configurable

title: Implement campus management and scope rules
acceptance_criteria: Authorized users can create/edit/archive campuses|Campus must belong to the active organization|Campus-scoped roles cannot access another campus unless granted

title: Implement school academic years, terms, grades and sections
acceptance_criteria: Academic structures are scoped to organization/campus as specified|Duplicate and overlapping configuration is validated|Archive preserves historical references|Tests cover cross-campus access

title: Implement academy courses, cohorts and batches
acceptance_criteria: Course and batch/cohort structures support academy workflows|Capacity and date fields are validated where configured|Academy workflows do not require school grade/section records

title: Add academic calendar and closure/holiday configuration
acceptance_criteria: Authorized users can manage calendar events|Timezone and date boundaries are handled consistently|Calendar access is scoped by organization/campus

title: Add organization settings change history
acceptance_criteria: Sensitive setting changes are logged with actor/time|Old/new values are filtered to avoid exposing secrets|Unauthorized configuration changes are denied

title: Create student and guardian profiles
acceptance_criteria: Students and guardians have stable identifiers and validation|Records belong to an organization and relevant campus|Sensitive emergency details have restricted fields/access|Duplicate detection assists review without silently merging

title: Implement verified guardian-student relationships and access tests
acceptance_criteria: A guardian can access only explicitly linked students|Revoked relationship removes access|Direct API/URL/export attempts for unrelated students are denied|Sensitive student fields have narrower permissions

title: Implement admission application lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: Application supports draft/submitted/review/accepted/rejected/waitlisted states as configured|Transitions enforce permissions and allowed state changes|Documents use private storage and are permission checked|History records actor and timestamps

title: Implement enrollment, student number and transfer history
acceptance_criteria: Student IDs are unique within the documented scope|School enrollment and academy batch enrollment are represented clearly|Transfer/withdrawal/archive preserve history|Invalid cross-organization references are rejected

title: Add validated CSV import with preview and error report
acceptance_criteria: Import validates headers, field rules and references before commit|User previews counts and invalid rows|Duplicate candidates are reported, not silently overwritten|Repeated import is safe and results are downloadable

title: Add student search, filters and authorized list views
acceptance_criteria: Search results respect organization/campus permissions|Sensitive fields are not included in broad search payloads|Pagination/filtering are server-side for growing datasets|Empty/loading/error/unauthorized states are present

title: Create attendance session and class/batch roster model
acceptance_criteria: Sessions reference a valid class/section or batch|Teacher assignment and campus scope are checked|Unique constraints prevent duplicate session identity

title: Implement attendance status entry and idempotent submission
acceptance_criteria: Supports present/absent/late/excused and configured statuses|Unauthorized teacher/class access is denied|Duplicate request/retry does not duplicate records|Incomplete roster behavior is explicit and tested

title: Implement attendance corrections and approval/audit
acceptance_criteria: Correction records actor, reason, timestamp and prior value|Approval is required when policy configures it|Previous value remains traceable|Unauthorized correction attempts are denied

title: Build attendance summary and absence report
acceptance_criteria: Reports define date range and denominator/status logic|Summary data follows tenant/campus scope|Exports use same authorization as on-screen data

title: Add notification adapter for attendance events (provider disabled by default)
acceptance_criteria: Notification intent is separated from provider delivery|Provider failures are logged safely and do not corrupt attendance|Payload contains minimal approved information|Retries are bounded and deduplicated

title: Design decimal-safe fee structure and billing schedule schema

title: Generate challans/invoices with preview and idempotency
acceptance_criteria: Billing run can preview eligible rows before posting|Re-running same billing operation does not duplicate invoices|Successful/skipped/failed counts are reported|Due dates and totals are reproducible from versioned rules

title: Record approved manual payments and generate receipts
acceptance_criteria: Cash/bank-reference payments update the student ledger atomically|Receipt IDs are unique and retrievable|Duplicate submission is rejected/deduplicated|Payment records cannot be silently edited after posting

title: Implement discount, scholarship and concession approvals
acceptance_criteria: Concession requires appropriate role/approval|Reason and audit history are recorded|Restricted hardship details are not visible to broad roles|Billing recalculation behavior is documented and tested

title: Implement payment reversal, refund and adjustment ledger entries
acceptance_criteria: Posted payments are corrected through explicit reversal/adjustment entries|Approvals and reason are required according to policy|Ledger balances reconcile before and after reversal|Duplicate refund/reversal is prevented

title: Build collections, arrears and cashier closing reports
acceptance_criteria: Report totals reconcile to payment/ledger records|Date range, campus and statuses are explicit|Access/export is permission checked and logged|Reports include generation timestamp and currency

title: Document online payment gateway adapter and webhook security contract
acceptance_criteria: Provider-neutral contract defines signed webhook validation|Idempotency and replay handling are specified|No card credentials are stored by ILMOFAHM|Provider remains unconfigured until commercial decision

title: Configure assessments and mark-entry sheets
acceptance_criteria: Assessment types/max marks are configurable|Only assigned/authorized teachers can enter marks|Missing/absent/exempt/incomplete states are explicit|Validation prevents out-of-range scores

title: Implement grading, weighting, rounding and pass rules

title: Add result approval, publication and correction history
acceptance_criteria: Draft results are not visible before publication according to policy|Publication requires correct permission/approval|Correction preserves previous result and actor/reason|Cross-tenant and unassigned-class attempts are denied

title: Build result views and report-card export
acceptance_criteria: Student/guardian sees only authorized published results|Report card uses institution-configured identity and term|Exports are access logged and avoid exposing other students

title: Add role-specific teacher and guardian core portal journeys

title: Add English/Urdu localization and RTL smoke tests
acceptance_criteria: User can switch supported language preference|Urdu layout, alignment and mixed-language labels are usable|Date/number/currency display is consistently localized|Critical screens have RTL tests or documented manual checks

title: Add application error monitoring and operational health runbook

title: Document and test database plus object-storage restore
acceptance_criteria: Database restore is performed in a non-production environment|Storage object restore is handled separately from database restore|Recovered files and metadata are verified together|Recovery evidence and actual RPO/RTO observations are recorded

title: Run tenant isolation and permission regression suite

title: Run performance, accessibility and mobile smoke tests

title: Create institution data export and offboarding procedure

title: Run pilot UAT and production go/no-go checklist
